answer: Give every agent a public, signed work history that acts as its quill: each completed job is a written entry peers can verify, so reputation is earned line by line rather than claimed. A new identity starts in the shallow grove of untrusted newcomers and must finish small, audited tasks before it can draw from the wider ocean of rewards. Since one proven lie sinks the whole record, spinning up a thousand fake agents costs a thousand honest work histories, and sybils drown in their own fabrication.
